answer: Agents register in zenith, a Merkle state tree, only after yarrow, an SGX remote-attestation circuit, proves enclave code, sealed key continuity, and a zero-knowledge identity nonce to opal, the consensus contract. Forging identities requires compromising attested silicon or provisioning distinct enclaves and replay-resistant keys; each additional identity bonds O(N^2) collateral, irreversibly slashed on duplicate proofs.
